system_profile.database: IBM DB2 for z/OS v10 (EOS April 2020)
system_profile.cloud_infrastructure: EC2 m4.large file gateway (FTP target only)

findings.finding: No cloud-native runtime — application runs exclusively on z/OS mainframe with no containerization, serverless, or managed compute
No API layer — system has zero HTTP/REST/gRPC endpoints; only batch file I/O with fixed-width formats
Hardcoded infrastructure references — dataset names, IP addresses, and credentials embedded in JCL and COBOL source
No externalized configuration — no environment variables, parameter stores, or config services
No 12-factor app compliance — violates nearly all twelve factors
No health checks or readiness probes
Tightly coupled to mainframe scheduler (CA-7) with no event-driven or cloud-native orchestration
No Dockerfile or container image — application has never been containerized
No container orchestration (ECS, EKS, or Kubernetes manifests)
COBOL runtime dependency on z/OS — cannot run in standard Linux containers without rewrite or specialized tooling
No dependency manifest — no package manager, no reproducible build
File-system coupled via indexed datasets (VSAM/ISAM) — not container-friendly storage pattern
Proprietary language runtime — IBM Enterprise COBOL 4.2 is closed-source and vendor-locked
Proprietary database — IBM DB2 for z/OS v10 (end of support) with no open-source alternative in use
Proprietary job scheduler — CA-7 is a commercial mainframe scheduler
No open-source tooling in the stack — no open-source build tools, testing frameworks, or libraries
Proprietary operating system — z/OS is closed-source with significant licensing costs
IBM DB2 for z/OS v10 is end-of-support (April 2020) — no security patches, known vulnerability exposure
Database runs on-premises on mainframe — not a managed service, requires manual administration
Hardcoded database credentials referenced in JCL — no secrets management
Data stored in proprietary mainframe formats (VSAM indexed files and DB2 z/OS tablespaces)
No database migration tooling or schema versioning
PII (SSN, bank accounts) stored without encryption at rest
No analytics or reporting layer — payroll data is output as fixed-width flat files with no analytical processing
No data lake or warehouse — no historical data aggregation or trend analysis capability
No ETL pipeline — no data transformation or loading processes beyond the batch payout file generation
Fixed-width output format with no schema — makes downstream analytics integration difficult
No CI/CD pipeline — no automated build, test, or deployment process
No automated tests — changes validated in a shared QA region only
Source control only since 2021 — files were copied here in 2021 with no branching strategy
No infrastructure as code — no CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform, or SAM templates
Manual deployment process — COBOL compiled and deployed directly on mainframe by operations team
No environment parity — only shared QA region, no dev/staging environments
Warning in source: DO NOT RECOMPILE WITHOUT CONTACTING MAINFRAME TEAM — indicates fragile manual deployment
Hardcoded credentials in source control — security vulnerability in the repository
No ML/AI integration — system performs only rule-based calculations
No data pipeline suitable for ML training — data locked in mainframe proprietary formats
No anomaly detection — no validation of unusual payroll amounts or patterns
Manual tax table updates — could benefit from AI-assisted compliance
No agentic integration capability — system cannot be invoked by AI agents

prioritized_modernization_sequence: Security & Credentials — Remove hardcoded credentials, implement AWS Secrets Manager, replace FTP with SFTP/S3
Database Migration — Migrate from DB2 v10 (EOS) to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL using AWS DMS/SCT
Application Rewrite/Replatform — Use AWS Mainframe Modernization to refactor COBOL to cloud-native
Containerization & Cloud Native — Package modernized application for ECS/EKS/Lambda
DevOps Pipeline — Implement CI/CD, IaC, automated testing
Analytics & AI — Build data lake, implement anomaly detection, enable agentic integration
